findings.title: Fix for NPE on concurrent group deletion is incomplete - sibling methods still dereference a possibly-null model
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() was patched to call `modelSupplier.get()` and check for null before invoking a method on it, but the sibling overloads `getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer)` (line 256), `getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer)` (line 262) and `getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer)` (line 268) still do `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` without any null check. These methods hit exactly the same underlying race described in the issue (the cached group's backing persistent entity being concurrently deleted so `cacheSession.getGroupDelegate().getGroupById(...)` returns null). Since these call paths are not protected, the same NullPointerException can still be thrown from these methods under concurrent group deletion, meaning the reported bug is only partially fixed.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount() now silently returns null, changing the method's implicit contract
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount()` previously threw an NPE when the backing group model vanished during concurrent access; the fix now returns `null` in that case (`return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();`). This changes observable behavior for every caller that assumed a non-null Long (e.g. UI/serialization code that expects a count, sorting/comparison logic, or future unboxing to a primitive). Returning null silently swaps a visible failure for a subtly wrong result (e.g. a group with unknown/zero subgroups reported as null) instead of handling the stale/invalidated-cache condition explicitly (e.g. refreshing the cache entry or falling back to a sensible value).

findings.title: New concurrency test leaks a background thread and has a race between thread completion and assertion
findings.body: The new `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti` test spawns a raw `Thread` that loops reading groups until `deletedAll` becomes true, but it never calls `thread.join()` before asserting `caughtExceptions` is empty (line 157). The main thread sets `deletedAll.set(true)` (line 155) and immediately asserts, without waiting for the background thread to observe the flag and actually stop; any exception thrown by the background thread's last in-flight call after the assertion has already run is never captured, so the test can report success even when the race condition it is meant to catch actually occurred (flaky false negative). Additionally, if an exception were thrown between starting the thread and `deletedAll.set(true)` (e.g. in the delete loop), the thread would never be stopped (no try/finally around setting the flag), leaking a thread that keeps hammering the admin REST API for the lifetime of the JVM/test run and potentially polluting subsequent tests.

findings.title: Unrelated removal of a helper method not explained by the PR description
findings.body: This PR, whose stated purpose is fixing an NPE on concurrent group cache access, also removes the private method `groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement` from `GroupUtils`. This change is unrelated to group caching/concurrency and is not mentioned in the PR description. If this method was leftover/dead code it's fine to clean up, but bundling an unrelated and unexplained removal into a bugfix PR makes the change harder to review and risks accidentally reverting logic intended for other in-flight work (e.g. a search/filter feature) without anyone noticing.
